surprises: AMGT_RESAPP-Z-W20-S9: Card 3 carries the DIVZ and PFOE presets as COUNTS AND WEIGHTS, not as factor-code lists: DIVZ names 7 of its 13 codes and PFOE 0 of its 16, so 22 of the 29 preset slots the fit is scored under have no code to read.

AMGT_RESAPP-Z-W20-S10: R-1's rows carry NO scanner factor values -- the ranker's loader keeps the 284-code set and drops the numbers by design -- so every fit score under DIVZ and PFOE is ABSENT, 0 of 13 and 0 of 16 factors present, for all four names of the QA pair.

AMGT_RESAPP-Z-W20-S11: The QA pair's COMPARABLES do not carry the four-part pack the order says landed: HD_US_Equity has no model block, and Boeing's rule-chosen comparable DE_US_Equity has none of D-1, M-1, R-1 or a model block -- so Boeing's posture was judged against a comparable whose only evidence is the seven facts Boeing's own peer row carries.

AMGT_RESAPP-Z-W20-S12: X-1 resolves 1 of BABA's 12 R-1 members and 0 of BA's 12, so 'R-1's members filtered to the other side's membership' had no key to filter on; the comparable step keys a member by the ranker's own scanner US ticker-space rule, and Boeing's comparable DE_US_Equity is a key that rule made and no registry carries.

AMGT_RESAPP-Z-W20-S13: membership returns held True / False / None, not the bool the order names: 167 of U-1's 170 holding rows carry security_key null, and four of Boeing's twelve R-1 peers (UNP, UBER, LMT, HWM) sit among them in DIVZ / PFOE / PFDE / PFDE -- a two-state key read calls them not held.

AMGT_RESAPP-Z-W20-S14: Both posture objects were RE-WRITTEN once after their model runs -- loaded from the pool, re-serialised by a fixed-order writer, re-PUT and read back, no model call -- because the first writer's sort_keys order put generation.run_id and generation.model past AC6's 120-character print.
